blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jesus had just fed a great crowd. Afterwards he sent his disciples ahead of him in the boat to the other side of the lake while he sent the people home. Then he went up a mountain by himself to pray. When evening came, he was there alone.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Out on the lake, the boat was in trouble. It was being tossed by the waves, because the wind was against them. The disciples rowed for hours and made little progress.

verses.text: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

verses.text: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: and they cried out for fear.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: In the fourth watch of the night, in the hours before dawn, they saw a figure coming toward them across the water. They were terrified. Then they heard a voice they knew.

verses.text: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

verses.text: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Peter answered him and said,

segments.speaker: peter
segments.text: Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Peter did not ask for the storm to stop. He asked to come to Jesus, where Jesus was, on the water.

verses.text: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Imagine Peter stepping over the side of the boat. The waves were still there. The wind was still blowing. And for a few steps, he walked toward Jesus on the water.

verses.text: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying,

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Peter looked at the wind and the waves, and fear took over. He began to sink. His prayer was three words long. It is one of the shortest prayers in the Bible, and one of the most honest.

verses.text: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Immediately. Jesus did not wait for Peter to sink further. He did not make him swim back to the boat. He reached out his hand and caught him. Then he gently asked him why he had doubted.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: People sometimes remember this story only for the sinking. But Peter was the one who got out of the boat. He walked on water, even briefly. When he started to sink, he knew whom to call, and the hand that caught him was already there.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: When they climbed into the boat together, the wind stopped.

verses.text: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying,

segments.speaker: disciples
segments.text: Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The disciples ended the night in worship. They had learned that the one walking on the water toward them was the Son of God. And they had watched him catch Peter the moment he cried out.

pastor.note: Faithful to Matthew 14:22-33; closing describes what the disciples saw, no promise that the listener will be caught from every fall.

cultural.note: Peter's doubt handled kindly; plain voice.
